measuredContracts.evidence: Wide UTF16, SMALL_CHARS 0x200 byte-per-UTF16-low-byte, with and without omitted rectangle, are separately byte-equal to Windows-rendered ExtTextOutW controls in all three engines. Compressed bytes80,e9 match UTF16 U+0080,U+00E9, not CP1252 Euro.

NO_RECT|CLIPPED and NO_RECT|OPAQUE both return successful GDI record/playback and GDI+ status0; their pixels equal ordinary NO_RECT without those flags in every engine. Missing rectangle makes these flags ineffectual in the sampled records.

Two glyph43 entries, compressed bytes versus UTF16words, pixel-equal separately in each Windows engine. This establishes zero-extension for this synthetic low glyph index, not all font/glyph combinations.

Ordinary fixed40-byte EMRTEXT arrays with valid explicitDX succeed. ETO_NO_RECT0x100 in fixed40 arrays fails PlayEnhMetaFileRecord and PlayEnhMetaFile for bothA/W; GDI+ DrawImage reports0 but paints nothing. A24-byte compact descriptor layout is rejected before enumeration callback and GDI+ DrawImage reportsGenericError1.

Successful two-string native PolyTextOutW records two EMR_EXTTEXTOUTW84 records, sizes88 and84, rather than one PolyTextOutW97 record. The native file is included in both artifacts.

correctedInitialControlAssumptions.reason: Initial no-DX Poly fixtures assumed natural spacing like ExtTextOut. Windows instead uses offDx0 as pointer to DWORD recordtype and subsequent record bytes; original controls are not source-parity controls. The focused followup proves this via placement and UPDATECP. Initial snapshots are intentionally preserved; revised implementation-branch control fixtures were not replayed in this reference run.

limits: No macOS raster comparison or pixel parity assertion.
Each exact equality is within the same Windows rendering engine. GDI and GDI+ raster results can differ.
Only these synthetic font/record samples and this Windows runner were measured.
DBCS sample covers Shift-JIS あH with three byte-DX distributions; other codepages and PDY byte grouping were not directly measured.
Compact glyph widening measured glyph43 only.
OffDx0 firstDWORD and current-position behavior directly measured; arbitrary later header/body DWORDs inferred from pointer semantics and require bounded source parsing.
No malformed allocation/count fuzzing or Windows API safety guarantee from these runs.
